context: Two friends chat about a laundry day mishap at the cafe
purpose: Teach: カレンダー/シャツ/ファミリー/出かける/受け取る/早々/嬉しく/両手

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 聞いてよ、今朝早々にやらかしちゃった。
lines.en: Listen, I messed up early this morning.
lines.style: Casual venting tone, warm and slightly self-deprecating among friends.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、何があったの?カレンダーに何か大事な予定でも書いてた?
lines.en: Huh, what happened? Did you have something important on the calendar?
lines.style: Soft concerned curiosity, gentle rising intonation, leaning in.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ううん、洗濯の日でね、真っ白いシャツを乾かしてたんだ。
lines.en: No, it was laundry day, I was drying a pure white shirt.
lines.style: Setting up a story, casual rhythm with mild sigh.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あ、もしかしてカフェに着てくお気に入りのやつ?
lines.en: Oh, you mean your favorite one you wear to the cafe?
lines.style: Sympathetic guess, soft tone, anticipating bad news.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そう。出かける前に取り込もうとしたら、両手にコーヒー豆の袋持ってて落としちゃって。
lines.en: Yeah. Before heading out I tried to grab it while holding coffee bean bags in both hands and dropped it.
lines.style: Animated regretful storytelling, gestures implied, exasperated chuckle.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ええっ、泥だらけ?ファミリーマートで新しいの買う羽目になったとか?
lines.en: Oh no, all muddy? Did you end up buying a new one at FamilyMart?
lines.style: Mock-horrified teasing, playful sympathy with friend.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それがね、隣のおばあちゃんが拾って洗ってくれて、さっき玄関で受け取るところだったの。
lines.en: Actually, the neighbor grandma picked it up and washed it, and I was just receiving it at the door.
lines.style: Surprised gratitude, voice softening into warmth gradually.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わあ、それは嬉しくて泣いちゃうやつじゃん。
lines.en: Wow, that's the kind of thing that makes you happy enough to cry.
lines.style: Heartfelt delight, romantic sigh, voice rising with emotion.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ほんとに。今度お礼にラテ持って行くつもり。
lines.en: Really. I'm planning to bring her a latte as thanks next time.
lines.style: Resolved cheerful closing, warm barista pride showing through.
